source_title: Hotmart Get Rich Without Going Viral
snippet_primary: "Before joining Hotmart, Martínez, the car repair creator, hadn't been able to charge clients outside of his native market of Costa Rica. Although many were willing to pay his $20 monthly subscription fee, they couldn't find a way around PayPal's geographic payment restrictions."
subject_exact: creator's pre-Hotmart inability to charge clients outside Costa Rica due to PayPal geographic payment restrictions (Rest of World)
local_qualifiers: Although many were willing to pay his $20 monthly subscription fee
parser_notes: Third-person journalistic narration of one creator's case; the $20 monthly subscription fee is the creator's own price, preserved as qualifier, not the principal metric of the claim (payment restriction).
